real_feel.formula_validation: comparative independent references; no synthetic single observed Real Feel target
real_feel.method: provider apparent production champion; Steadman/wind-chill fallback; local residual remains shadow-only while independent formula replay accumulates

real_feel_formula_replay.method: Issued Real Feel candidates are compared prospectively against separate external references derived from target-time ECCC meteorology; no candidate formula is declared observed human-perception truth.
real_feel_formula_replay.promotion_policy: diagnostic-only while the independent replay accumulates; Real Feel formula changes are not auto-promoted from the legacy synthetic target

references.bom_steadman_shade: Steadman apparent temperature using observed temperature, humidity and wind
references.eccc_humidex: ECCC Humidex only when air temperature is at least 20 C and Humidex is at least 1 C above air temperature
references.eccc_wind_chill: Canadian wind chill when observed temperature/wind satisfy the cold-weather formula inputs

walk_forward_verification.note: V2/V3 are reconstructed from archived family states; prospective shadow verification remains authoritative for the deployed final blend and observation nudge.
